meta.title: Try to purchase two BOQ-based PRs together

plan.title: Block purchasing two BOQ PRs together

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions screen as the buyer.
Ensure the PR list is on the Open tab, where purchase actions are available.

args.goal: select two BOQ-based purchase requisitions together, hover over Purchase Items to read the disabled-control message, and attempt to click Purchase Items; leave the PR list showing both selected BOQ PRs

steps.note: Selects the two BOQ PRs and performs the required hover and click attempt, which no specialized catalog step can express.
Assert that Purchase Items remains disabled after selecting both BOQ PRs.

args.text: Multiple BOQ-based PR cannot be purchased together

steps.note: Assert the exact restriction message shown for the disabled action.
